messages.body: Not urgent: could failed webhook deliveries retry with exponential backoff? We currently poll the API to recover from brief receiver outages. A delivery log with replay would also help.

messages.subject: How can we rotate API keys without downtime?
messages.body: Our security review is next week. Can two API keys overlap while we deploy the replacement, or does creating a new key revoke the current one immediately?

messages.subject: Re: How can we rotate API keys without downtime?
messages.body:
Hi Sofia,

Keys can overlap. Create a second key, deploy it, verify traffic, and then revoke the old key. Creating the replacement does not invalidate the current key.

Regards,
Acme Support

messages.subject: Re: Audit log missing SCIM group changes
messages.body: Quick follow-up on req_7Q4K2. Our compliance export still omits SCIM group membership changes from yesterday afternoon. Do those events appear under scim.group_membership_updated rather than user.provisioned?

messages.subject: Re: Audit log missing SCIM group changes
messages.body:
Hi Leila,

Group membership changes are logged as scim.group_membership_updated. Filters that only include user.provisioned will miss them. I attached the export field list our docs recommend for SCIM audits.

Regards,
Acme Support
